name: red-baroque-archery-editorial
image_vibe: Romantic red baroque couture with focused archery gesture and rich monochrome studio drama
image_purpose: Create a cinematic Cupid-inspired fashion editorial portrait for campaign or lookbook use.

prompt.project_info: A 2:3 cinematic fashion editorial portrait of the adult woman from the required approved-adult identity reference in a romantic baroque Cupid studio scene.
prompt.main_subject: The adult woman from the required approved-adult identity reference, preserving her face, facial features, bone structure, and expression structure. She has long dark hair flowing naturally and performs a dynamic bow-aiming pose with correct shoulder mechanics and hand articulation. She wears a deep red baroque corset dress with a structured bodice and layered skirt, plus white lace gloves with red ribbon bows.
prompt.composition_elements: Portrait-oriented 2:3 framing, dynamic archery pose, focused sideways gaze, ornate carved glossy red baroque bow, deep red arrow, smooth pink-to-red gradient studio backdrop, and clear separation of the subject from the background.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dramatic fashion studio lighting with soft frontal diffused key, subtle warm rim light on hair and shoulders, clean soft shadows, natural luminous skin, rich monochrome red-pink palette, and cinematic editorial contrast.
prompt.technical_specs: 85mm prime lens, f/1.8, shallow depth of field with face fully sharp and eyes razor sharp, subtle film grain, realistic fabric weave, folds, bow lacquer, glove lace, hair, and skin texture, high-resolution clarity, no text or watermark.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a cinematic 2:3 fashion editorial portrait using the required approved-adult identity reference. Preserve the adult woman's exact face, facial features, bone structure, and expression structure. Give her long dark hair flowing naturally and pose her dynamically aiming an ornate carved glossy red baroque bow, with correct shoulder mechanics, five natural fingers on each hand, and a deep red arrow. Dress her in a deep red baroque corset dress with a structured bodice and layered skirt, plus white lace gloves with red ribbon bows. Set the scene against a smooth pink-to-red gradient studio backdrop. Use soft frontal diffused key light, subtle warm rim light on hair and shoulders, clean soft shadows, natural luminous skin texture, an 85mm prime lens at f/1.8, shallow depth of field with the face fully sharp, subtle film grain, realistic fabric weave and folds, polished bow lacquer, lace, hair, and skin detail, rich monochrome red-pink cinematic grading, and no text or watermark.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, nudity, minor or teen-coded subject, identity drift, face alteration, distorted anatomy, extra fingers, incorrect bow grip, warped bow, plastic skin, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, low resolution, watermark, text
